description: Binary melting systems: which pairs of solids form a single alloy when melted together and re-frozen. A pair that is not listed is a physical mixture and each component melts on its own.

eutectic_mass_fraction_b.source: https://www.metallurgy.nist.gov/phase/solder/bisn.html (56.97 mass % Bi); the PMC5578286 paper rounds to 58 wt % (fetched 2026-11-28)

systems.liquidus_note: Only the two melting points and the eutectic point were found in fetched sources; the real liquidus curves between them are curved, so liquidus temperatures at other compositions are an approximation.

terminal_solid_solubility.source: https://www.metallurgy.nist.gov/phase/solder/bisn.html (21.01 mass % Bi in (Sn) and 0.11 mass % Sn in (Bi) at the eutectic temperature); the model neglects these solid solutions
